name: Dhund
description: The Dhund is the Consulate's secret prison and headquarters in tunnels beneath Gonti's night market in Ghirapur, run by Baral.

description_citations.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.
"Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

summary.text: The Dhund is the Consulate's secret prison and headquarters in tunnels beneath Gonti's night market in Ghirapur, run by Baral.

citations.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.
"Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

bio.text: Pia Nalaar was held in a Dhund cell, where Baral taunted her about her daughter.

citations.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.
"Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

bio.text: Chandra, Nissa and Mrs. Pashiri found the Dhund behind an illusory wall, but Baral trapped them in a cell filling with poison.

citations.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.
"Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.
"Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

bio.text: Ajani entered the Dhund, healed their poisoned blood and led them out.

citations.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.
"Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

bio.text: After the reformed Consulate emptied and demolished the Dhund, freeing hundreds of prisoners, Pia and Chandra visited the imprisoned Baral and left him to be forgotten.

citations.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.
"Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

bio.text: During the Phyrexian assault Baral escaped his damaged prison.

citations.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: It was demolished except for its intact core, and Baral later escaped his damaged prison.

citations.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.
"Dhiren Baral", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a Dhund cell Baral tells Pia he killed her daughter and tosses a melted piece of Chandra's vent pack, stamped K.N. and the leaking spire, as a memento (flashback).
timeline.quote: I killed your daughter today, Pia.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia recognizes the fragment as part of Kiran Nalaar's final project.
timeline.quote: a piece of Kiran Nalaar's final project

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral returns every day repeating that Chandra was looking for Pia, until Pia vows to return to expose him.
timeline.quote: And I'll return for her, for all those out there, so they know what you've done.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia hurls an aether lamp that knocks off Baral's mask, revealing a blue flash, so he is a mage, and a scarred face.
timeline.quote: dislodged his mask with a clanging reverberation

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral blames Chandra for his scars and Pia answers that a mother could not be prouder.
timeline.quote: this is the work of your child.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Alone in the dark, Pia begins to plan her escape.
timeline.quote: And began to plan.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni reads the enforcer's energy to learn Pia is held in Dhund prison.
timeline.quote: Dhund prison?

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni tells them Pia is at Dhund and Mrs. Pashiri warns that Baral is stationed there.
timeline.quote: Baral is stationed there.

citation.text: "Born of Aether" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Mrs. Pashiri leads Chandra and Nissa to Gonti's night market, since the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath it.
timeline.quote: I'm told the Dhund lies in tunnels beneath the night market.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa admits she cannot find Pia directly in the tunnels.
timeline.quote: Finding your mother down here is another matter entirely.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra snaps at Nissa asking if she even has a mother, and Nissa reveals that Ulamog destroyed her people's home of Bala Ged.
timeline.quote: it was the first place he destroyed

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra erupts at Mrs. Pashiri for leading them around in circles.
timeline.quote: You've been leading us around in circles while they have my mom?

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra steps through an illusory wall and discovers it is not real.
timeline.quote: disappearing through the stone as if it were a wall of water

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Beyond the illusion, the tunnels become clean, well-lit corridors lined with bureaucrats' offices.
timeline.quote: The tunnel network was utterly transformed.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Armored figures surround them and a scarred man, Baral, unmasks.
timeline.quote: One of the figures reached up and pulled off a filigree mask that covered his face.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra's firestorm is absorbed into Baral's hand device.
timeline.quote: the flames vanished as they reached him

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral raises walls that trap the three in a sealed chamber.
timeline.quote: she slammed into a wall that shot up from the floor

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral says Baan told him she was back and promises she will not escape again.
timeline.quote: Baan said you were back. I couldn't believe it.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral calls Chandra a pathetic freak of nature and tells her to burn all she likes and die more quickly.
timeline.quote: You'll die more quickly if you burn up the air.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa touches Chandra's back and briefly feels Chandra's fire in her soul.
timeline.quote: A channel opened between them

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra begs Baral to let the others and her mother go and kill only her, but he refuses.
timeline.quote: Kill me, just me.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra's wave of fire reflects back on her, and Nissa shields Mrs. Pashiri with her cloak.
timeline.quote: throwing her cloak over Mrs. Pashiri and trying to shield the older woman with her body

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa realizes poison vapor is leaking into the cell to suffocate them faster.
timeline.quote: He means for us to suffocate more quickly after all.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Cut off from the earth, Nissa recalls her only other equal isolation, when Ob Nixilis tore Ashaya from her (flashback).
timeline.quote: when the demon Ob Nixilis had disrupted the ley lines on Zendikar and torn Ashaya from her

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Nissa offers to fuel Chandra's fire with her mana to try to melt the door's hinges.
timeline.quote: Let me fuel your fire,

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Their focused flame fails against the counterspell and fizzles out.
timeline.quote: the last flames fizzling out in her hand

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra tells Nissa that the Gatewatch is about not being alone and having a family on any plane.
timeline.quote: Having a family, no matter what plane we're on.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra refuses to leave the dying Mrs. Pashiri, and Nissa says she will stay with them, thinking of Chandra as her friend.
timeline.quote: I'll stay here with Mrs. Pashiri.

citation.text: "Bottled Up" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan charges Baral with murder, attempted murder, and other crimes; he is imprisoned in the Dhund.
timeline.quote: Dhiren Baral was imprisoned in the Dhund

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The trio locates the hidden Dhund but Baral, warned by Dovin Baan, lures them into a Deadlock Trap.
timeline.quote: Baral lured the group into an airtight, enchanted Deadlock Trap

citation.text: "Oviya Pashiri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani frees them and the planeswalkers bring Oviya to safety.
timeline.quote: They were freed by Ajani

citation.text: "Oviya Pashiri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vatti organizes young lifecrafters and plans to infiltrate the Dhund.
timeline.quote: Vatti organized a group of young lifecrafters to aid in the search

citation.text: "Vatti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde learns through Mihir's bird that Pashiri was spotted at the Dhund.
timeline.quote: Pashiri was spotted twenty minutes ago.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde explains the Dhund is a secret Consulate headquarters beneath Gonti's night market.
timeline.quote: The Dhund is a headquarters the Consuls built under and through Gonti's market.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Following the mechanical bird, Ajani enters the Dhund and knocks out a guard.
timeline.quote: He backhanded the guard into the wall and winced at the sudden scent of blood.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani sees a hand weakly strike the window of a poison box, and realizes it holds his friends.
timeline.quote: A fist struck the glass. Then a hand, weakly.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani vaults the rail, sheds Grandmother's cloak and gauntlets and attacks the guards at the poison chamber.
timeline.quote: They unclasped and fell away.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani swings for a guard's throat but reads his soul and decides he is just a man.
timeline.quote: Not a Planeswalker. Not a villain.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani smashes the guard's chestplate without killing him and sends the other fleeing.
timeline.quote: It smashed across the guard's chestplate, scattering twisted metal shards across the marble floor.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani pries open the poison container door with his axe.
timeline.quote: he peeled the screeching machine open.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani finds Nissa with an unconscious Chandra and Grandmother Pashiri barely breathing.
timeline.quote: Grandmother lay eyes closed and barely breathing.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani heals Grandmother Pashiri's poisoned blood.
timeline.quote: burning away the black, filling her blood with clean air

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani heals Chandra's poisoned blood and lungs.
timeline.quote: Silver tendrils of healing magic raced through her, cleansing the impurities

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: As guards assemble, a rope drops through the window and Ajani leads them out.
timeline.quote: We have a ride,

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani lets the guard he struck go home, repeating that he does not kill anymore.
timeline.quote: Go home to your family,

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana leaves to alert the Gatewatch while Chandra, Nissa and Mrs. Pashiri go to the Dhund, where Baral traps them in a cell filling with poison.
timeline.quote: He traps the would-be rescuers in a cell that rapidly fills with poison.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane storms in and rescues them from the cell.
timeline.quote: the door to the cell flies open, and in storms a leonin warrior come to rescue them: Ajani Goldmane.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The Consulate declares martial law and militarizes Ghirapur while the Dhund hunts renegade networks.
timeline.quote: the Consulate declared martial law and transformed the city into a heavily militarized zone.

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "The Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The reformed Consulate empties and demolishes the Dhund, freeing hundreds of prisoners, mostly mages and renegades.
timeline.quote: Hundreds of prisoners—most of them mages and renegades who had "disappeared" long ago—were released in the space of a couple hours.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Pia and Chandra walk through the ruined Dhund to the intact core.
timeline.quote: Pia and Chandra Nalaar made their way through the ruined hallways toward the compound's intact core.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Pia and Chandra visit the cell of the scarred, imprisoned Baral, who demands his execution and goads Chandra to kill him.
timeline.quote: "Baral." Pia said.

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Baral taunts Chandra about her father's death, but she refuses to be a monster and leaves him to be forgotten.
timeline.quote: "Screw you," she said. "I don't owe you a damn thing."

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Pia tells Baral that they leave him; Chandra leaves a jasmine flower at the cell.
timeline.quote: "My daughter and I leave you today," Pia said. "Stay and be forgotten."

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian assault Baral escapes his damaged prison and is confronted by Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: he wasted no time in making his escape

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
